title: Plan GROUP BY aggregate ORDER BY/LIMIT fast path
problem: Simple GROUP BY aggregate queries with ORDER BY aggregate and LIMIT could not use the direct column aggregate scan because the fast path rejected ORDER BY/LIMIT and fell back to row materialization.
approach: Allow the simple GROUP BY column aggregate scan to run when ORDER BY and LIMIT are present.
Sort the small grouped result set by output projection column, alias, aggregate expression, or ordinal.
Apply OFFSET/LIMIT after sorting the grouped result rows.
Keep WHERE, JOIN, HAVING, expression aggregates, and unsupported ORDER BY expressions on the generic path or return the existing error semantics.
expected_impact: Improve Event counts by type and Daily revenue top30.
risk_controls: Reuse existing direct group aggregate result shape.
Add SQL integration coverage for ORDER BY alias and ORDER BY aggregate expression with LIMIT.
